idea-plugin.name: GitToolBoxFree
idea-plugin.description:
GitToolBoxFree is a lightweight, high-performance, and bilingual (English / 简体中文) Git productivity enhancement plugin for IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio.

Features

  • Inline Blame: Non-blocking inline line blame displaying author, relative time (3 days ago / 3天前), and commit message.
  • Typing Suppression: Automatically hides annotations while typing for a buttery-smooth 120fps native typing experience.
  • Status Bar Indicator: Shows branch name and ahead/behind counts (↑ahead | ↓behind) with smart multi-repository tracking.
  • Silent Auto-Fetch: Periodically fetches changes in the background with rebase/merge safe evasion.
  • Bilingual Settings: One-click switch between English and 简体中文 under Settings -> Version Control -> GitToolBoxFree.

中文说明

GitToolBoxFree 是一款专为 Android Studio 与 IntelliJ 打造的完全免费、轻量级、极致流畅、中英双语的 Git 效率增强插件。

  • 行内代码责任人 (Inline Blame)：光标所在行末即时浅灰显示提交人、相对时间（“3天前”、“昨天” / "3 days ago"）及提交信息。高性能防抖渲染，编码丝滑不卡顿。
  • 状态栏仓库指示器 (Status Bar)：右下角实时展示当前分支、领先/落后提交数（↑超前 | ↓落后），支持悬浮气泡提示与快捷菜单。
  • 后台自动拉取 (Auto Fetch)：静默定时执行 git fetch，保持远程提交计数实时准确。
  • 双语设置面板 (Multi-Language Settings)：在“设置 -> Version Control (版本控制) / Other Settings -> GitToolBoxFree”中自由切换中英文界面、定制显示模板与防抖时间。
